name: Machine Gripless Shrug
steps: Stand inside a shoulder-pad shrug or standing calf-raise machine with your shoulders positioned squarely beneath the padded levers and your feet planted firmly hip-width apart.
Stand tall with your knees softly unlocked, core braced, and hands resting lightly on the support handles or at your sides without pulling.
Shrug your shoulders straight upward toward your ears by contracting your upper traps strongly.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the pads slowly back down until your traps feel stretched.
tips: Lift your shoulders straight up and down rather than rolling them in circles.
Keep your head neutral instead of jutting your chin forward during the shrug.
